Good to know

Questions, answered.

Don't see yours? Call (303) 419-2389 — a real person answers.

What does title insurance protect against?

Title insurance protects you against defects in the chain of title found in public records—including unpaid taxes, fraudulent or forged documents, incorrectly recorded documents, spurious liens, undisclosed claims from previous owners, and undisclosed easements. If a claim arises, your insurer will fix the problem, defend you, or compensate you for losses.

How does Homestead protect my funds during closing?

We partner with CertifID to verify wire instructions and recipient identity before funds transfer, with up to $1 million in direct insurance per transaction. We also carry Employee Dishonesty and Crime Insurance—covering wire fraud interception—which exceeds standard industry requirements. Westcor issues Closing Protection Letters to both buyers and lenders at no additional charge, guaranteeing funds sent to us.

What types of title orders can I place online?

You can order refinance orders, limited title orders, ownership & encumbrance orders, and foreclosure orders online. We also offer national refinance orders and quotes for lenders nationwide through our National Lender Division.

Do you offer virtual or remote closings?

Yes. We provide Remote Online Notary (RON) and virtual/hybrid closing services to accommodate your schedule and location needs.

Is there a military discount?

Yes. Active and retired military veterans receive a 20% discount on the closing fee. Ask your escrow officer for details.

What underwriters back Homestead Title?

We are underwritten by First American (A Unsurpassed rating), Westcor Land Title (A Prime rating), Alliant National Title (A Prime rating), and First National Title. All carry A Prime or higher ratings from Demotech, ensuring your investment is protected by the industry's most financially stable firms.
